0542Statistics

Quant Desk (OpenEnv Arena)

Akahsizrr/quant-desk

Read a small brief such as a log, invoice or ruleset, compute the exact value requested and reply with one JSON answer.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • strict reply-format discipline
  • analyst-style precision
  • small OpenEnv Arena runs

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Graded, 0 to 1

Each answer is graded by a per-task grader (integer, numeric tolerance, choice, set F1, JSON fields or string); the final reward is the best of up to three attempts.

How to run it

1. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download Akahsizrr/quant-desk --repo-type dataset --local-dir quant-desk

Framework documentation: OpenEnv. Needs: Docker image ghcr.io/vaskrokodile/quant-desk:v1 (linux/amd64).
